subject: Splitter ram stuck out
body: So we have a little cabin up north and the FH-210 comes out maybe four or five weekends a year, mostly when my husband decides we need a winter's worth of firewood in one go. Last Saturday it split about six logs just fine, and then on the seventh the ram went forward and just stayed there. Won't come back. The pump makes this high whiny sound the whole time I hold the lever, like it's working hard and getting nowhere. We shut it off and waited a while, tried again, same thing. Our serial is FH210-22-04471 if that helps. Is this something we can fix ourselves, or should we send it somewhere? We're only up there until Sunday and I'd love to have an answer before the next trip. Thanks so much, and the machine has been great otherwise!

subject: Stump grinder performance
body:
To whom it may concern,

I purchased an FH-520 stump grinder as a gift for my father last spring. He has used it several times. He reports that it now cuts far more slowly than before, and when I looked at the cutting wheel, a few of the teeth appeared worn down and at least one looked chipped. Could you please advise whether the teeth are replaceable, and how I can obtain the correct ones?

Regards,
Margaret Oyelaran

subject: chipper noise
body: hey my fh340 engine runs fine but the drum wont turn and theres a loud squeal comming from under the guard. shut it off rite away. whats wrong with it. thx

subject: Pressure washer leaking, no pressure
body: Need help fast. Left my FH-P90 in the unheated garage and we had a hard cold snap overnight, down in the teens. This morning I hooked it up to the hose, started it, and water is coming out of the pump housing near the bottom, a steady drip that turns into a stream when I squeeze the trigger. At the wand I get a weak dribble, nothing like the normal spray. I turned it off immediately. I did not put anything in the pump before storing it, which maybe was my mistake. I have about 400 feet of fence and a barn that I need to wash down before the weekend, since my in-laws are coming to see the property. Order number FE-104233 if you need to look it up. Is the pump ruined? Can the pump be replaced by itself or do I need a whole new unit? Please reply by email, I'm out in the fields most of the day and my phone doesn't get good signal. Thanks.

subject: FH-340 vibration
body: Good afternoon. My FH-340 chipper has begun to shake violently during operation and makes a rattling sound. The chips it produces are stringy and uneven. Kindly advise on the cause and the recommended next steps.

subject: Generator - no power at outlets
body: Got the FH-G7 out to the back property to run a few tools. Engine starts and sounds normal, runs smooth. But when I plug anything into the outlets, nothing happens. No power at all. I think I saw the breaker button pop out once, not sure. Tried two different extension cords. I haven't opened anything up. What should I check before I haul it in for repair? Thanks.

subject: Cortadora de troncos muy lenta
body: Buenas, tengo una FH-210 en mi pequeña granja y ya no está rindiendo. El ariete avanza muy despacio y a veces se detiene por completo con troncos que antes partía sin problema. Necesito la máquina funcionando pronto porque tengo mucha leña pendiente. ¿Qué puede ser? ¿El aceite hidráulico, la bomba? Díganme qué revisar o dónde la puedo llevar a reparar. Gracias.

subject: Question about my generator
body:
Dear Fernhollow team,

I am a first-time owner of a portable generator and I have a few questions. I bought the FH-G7 in September, mainly for backup during storm season, and I ran it last Tuesday for about forty minutes to test it. It started on the second pull and produced power as expected. I did notice some gas dripping near the engine, down by the muffler, while it was running, though I assumed that might be normal for a new unit. The more important thing I wanted to ask is whether the unit should be run on a gravel or concrete surface, as I have only used it on the lawn so far. The manual does not seem clear on this point. Also, how often should I check the oil level during a long run? I would appreciate a reply at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Priscilla Armitage

subject: FH 520 belt squeal
body: Cutter wheel on the FH 520 just stops dead as soon as it touches the stump and the belt screams. Tried a smaller stump, same thing. Running behind on a clearing job so please tell me what to check, belt tension? Bad belt?

subject: Smoke from generator panel
body: Hi there! Hoping you can help me out. Been running my FH-G7 for a couple of hours at the farm while we had the power out, hooked up the freezer and a couple of lights, and out of nowhere there was this burning-plastic smell and a little puff of smoke coming from the control panel. I shut it down right then and there and let it sit. Haven't started it since. Everything was working fine up until then! I'd really like to get the freezer going again. What should I do, and is it safe to run it again at all? Thanks a bunch!

subject: FH-210 question
body: Hi, bit of a long one. My wife and I have the FH-210 at our cabin, it's the one with the horizontal beam, and we finally got around to splitting the stack that has been sitting by the shed since July. First half hour was fine. We took a break for coffee, the dog got into the neighbor's yard, usual stuff. Anyway, one of the knotty oak rounds kicked a chunk off the wedge and it caught me on the shin, I'm okay, just a bruise. What I really want to know is whether the wedge or the guard needs adjusting, because my wife thinks we set something up wrong. Serial is FH210-23-09120. Please let me know.

subject: Won't start after winter
body: Pulled the FH-340 out of the shed this weekend after it sat since last October. Pulled the cord about thirty times, it sputters once or twice and dies. Tank still has old gas in it. Do I drain it? Need it running by Saturday, we have a lot of brush to clear around the cabin.

subject: Warranty question - stump grinder
body: Good morning. I have owned an FH-520 stump grinder for approximately five months. It has been used according to the manual on my property, for occasional stump removal. The cutter wheel has now stopped turning under load and a grinding noise has developed. I would like to know what the next step is and whether this repair would be covered under warranty. Please advise what documents you require. My order number is FE-107789.

subject: Pressure washer pulsing
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I hope this note finds you well. My name is Gerald Mansfield and I live in a small ranch house outside of town, where my wife and I have lived for twenty-six years. I mention this only because the house is due for its first proper washing in over a decade. Our oldest granddaughter is getting married in the backyard in three weeks, and my wife has decided that the siding, the patio, and the walkway must all be spotless. I am a retired surveyor, and I do not mind a project, but this one has become urgent.

My difficulty is as follows. The FH-P90 pressure washer I purchased in the spring has begun to deliver low pressure, and the spray now pulses and surges, so that the wand kicks in my hand. It was fine at the start of the summer. I have checked that the hose is not kinked and the water supply is on fully. Could you tell me what typically causes this, and what I should inspect or replace?

My neighbor, incidentally, has offered to lend me his own washer, but I would rather fix my own. Thank you for your time.

Respectfully,
Gerald Mansfield

subject: Generador no arranca
body: Buenas tardes. Mi generador FH-G7 no quiere arrancar. Jalo la cuerda y está muy dura, casi no se mueve, y cuando logro jalarla no enciende. Lo usé hace dos meses sin problemas. ¿Qué debo revisar? Gracias de antemano.

subject: FH-340 jams constantly - refund
body: This is unacceptable. I have owned the FH-340 chipper for a few months, used only at the cabin on weekends, and it jams every time I feed it anything green or leafy. I have spent more time clearing it than chipping. I want my money back, in full, or a brand-new replacement shipped to me immediately. I expect a response today, not a form letter in two weeks.

subject: Hydraulic leak
body: Good evening. During my last use of the FH-210, I noticed hydraulic fluid dripping from one of the hose fittings near the cylinder. A small puddle formed under the machine. I have stopped using it. Could you tell me whether I can tighten the fitting myself or whether a part needs replacing? I use the splitter only a few weekends each year at the cabin.

subject: Maintenance schedule
body:
Dear Fernhollow,

I am a retired gentleman with several acres of woods, and I have recently acquired an FH-210 log splitter. I would like to maintain it properly. Could you tell me how often the hydraulic oil and filter should be changed, how I should care for the splitting wedge, and how best to store the machine through the winter months? I would also appreciate knowing which oil type you recommend.

Thank you,
Walter Dunleavy

subject: Generator shuts off
body: My FH-G7 shuts off by itself. Any ideas, please?

subject: Hose burst
body: Hey, hose fitting burst on my FH-P90 and got my hand!

subject: Stump grinder won't start
body: Hello, I hope you can help. I have a stump grinder that I use on the farm, and it sat in the barn all through the summer without being touched. Today I went to start it and the engine just turns over and over without catching. I haven't done anything to it since I put it away. Could you let me know whether it might be the old fuel, or something else I should look at? I would be grateful for any advice. Thank you kindly.

subject: nothing works off the generator
body: just got my FH-G7 last week. first time using it. engine fires up fine but i plug in my tools and nothing. not even a light. the little red button thing near the outlets sticks out now. is it broken?? i need to finish the shed wiring job tomorrow

subject: Cutter wheel stalling
body: Hi! Brand new to stump grinding and my FH-520 keeps stalling out when the wheel hits the wood, plus the belt makes a horrible squealing sound. Is that normal for a new machine or did I do something wrong? Thanks!!

subject: Smoke + burning smell FH-G7
body: Running late so short version of a long day. Power went out on our road Thursday and I fired up the FH-G7 for the well pump and the fridge. Ran fine for the first hour, then I plugged in the space heater and the welder cord since I figured it could handle it, and about ten minutes later there was a hot electrical smell and a thin line of smoke coming off the control panel. I killed it and walked away. It's cooling in the shed now. Anyway what I actually need to know is what could cause that and if I can get the panel looked at or replaced. The warranty paperwork is somewhere in the truck. Serial is FH-G7-23-01954, I think, the sticker is half scratched. We still have no power at the house so please get back to me on my cell or email. Thanks.

subject: chipper jamming w/ green branches
body: Hello! Love the idea of the FH-340 but I'm having some trouble. We're clearing a lot of green maple and some leafy stuff after the storm, and the chipper keeps clogging up. I have to stop and pull stuff out of the chute every few minutes. Is that expected with wet branches, or is there a setting I'm missing? The drier stuff goes through fine. Any tips appreciated, we only use it a few weekends a year so I'm not an expert.

subject: Log kicked off splitter
body: Hello, I am writing because last weekend while using my FH-210, a piece of log flew off the splitter wedge and struck me on the leg. I am bruised but otherwise fine. I would like to understand what went wrong. I was splitting a fairly dry round of ash, standing at the side. Was I doing something incorrectly, or could there be a problem with the machine? I would appreciate your guidance before I use it again. Thank you.

subject: FH-G7 will not start
body: Good day. I gave my mother an FH-G7 generator for her birthday. She tells me it will not start and the pull cord is extremely stiff. Please advise on how to proceed.

subject: fluid leaking from splitter
body: Hi folks, I noticed some hydraulic fluid dripping from a hose fitting on my FH 210 after the last couple of uses, and now there's a wet spot on the cylinder end too. Not a huge amount but it's growing. Is this something I can fix with a wrench or is it more serious? Please let me know what part I should order if it needs replacing. Thanks very much.

subject: Ram too slow, so frustrated
body: I bought this FH-210 two months ago and the ram is crawling. It used to blast through logs and now it stalls on anything thicker than my forearm. I've never owned one of these before so I have no idea if I broke something. I've watched two videos online and they're no help. Can someone tell me what to check? Honestly starting to regret the purchase. Order FE-109155.

subject: Pressure washer stopped working
body: Hello, I gave my dad an FH-P90 pressure washer for Father's Day this year. He used it a handful of times and now it won't build pressure and the engine sounds strained. He is not very comfortable with technology so I am writing on his behalf. Can you tell me what we should do, and whether a repair at this age would be covered by the warranty? We still have the receipt. Thank you very much for your help.

subject: Maintenance question
body: I just want to make sure I'm looking after my FH-210 right. How often do I change the engine oil, and what about the hydraulic fluid? Anything I should do with the wedge? And what's the right way to store it for the winter? I'm out on the farm most days so a quick list works fine. Thanks.

subject: Astilladora no gira el tambor
body:
Estimados señores de Fernhollow:

Les escribo porque soy nueva con este tipo de equipo. Compré una astilladora FH-340 hace unas semanas y la he usado muy poco. Hoy, al encenderla, el motor funciona con normalidad, pero el tambor de la astilladora no gira y se escucha un chirrido fuerte, como si algo estuviera rozando o patinando. Apagué el motor inmediatamente para no causar más daño. No sé si es la correa, un problema del embrague o algo que hice mal. Antes de intentar cualquier cosa por mi cuenta, quisiera saber qué debo revisar y si es seguro volver a encenderla. También quisiera saber si debo llevarla a algún taller autorizado o si pueden indicarme cómo repararla yo misma. Mi número de pedido es FE-110482. Quedo atenta a su respuesta.

Atentamente,
Alejandra Montoya

subject: Splitter ram stuck
body:
Good morning from Vermont. I hope you are well. Let me explain my situation a bit. I retired from teaching shop class in the spring and my wife and I bought a lot with a lot of old maples, and my plan has been to heat the place with wood this winter. My son-in-law told me about your company and I bought the FH-210 in August. I've had my share of trouble in life with small engines, so I wasn't worried. The first month went great.

Now the thing is, the ram goes forward on a split and then will not come back. The pump just whines the whole time I hold the lever. I am quite frustrated, because I have about nine cords sitting there and the temperature is dropping. I am a patient man but I am running out of time. Can you tell me what is likely wrong and whether I can fix it myself or need to send it in? Serial FH210-24-01733.

My wife says to also tell you the machine is a handsome piece of equipment, for whatever that's worth.

subject: Generator keeps cutting out
body: My generator at the cabin starts up fine, runs for maybe three or four minutes, and then just dies. No warning, no sputtering, it just quits. I only use it a few weekends a year and it's been doing this the last two trips. I've topped up the gas both times and the tank was full, so I don't think that's it. It's a portable one from you guys, bought maybe a year and a half ago, the big one that's meant to run a few appliances. I was running just a couple of lights and the water pump when it happened, so not a heavy load. I'm up there again in two weeks and would really like to get this sorted before then. Is this something I should be able to fix, or does it need a shop? Please advise.

subject: Hose fitting failure on pressure washer
body: Hello, I'd like to ask about my FH-P90. I've been using it to clean the barn and the equipment shed, which has been a good use of the weekend so far. The unit has been running well. During the last session one of the high-pressure hose fittings burst and sprayed my husband's hand, he had to get it looked at but it's healing, and then we shut everything down. I'm hoping you can tell me which fitting that is and whether you sell a replacement. I'd also like to know if the hose itself should be replaced. We've got more cleaning to do before the weather turns. Thanks for your help.

subject: FH-P90 pulsing
body:
Hi, ok so this is going to be a bit all over the place, sorry. I just bought my first house in March, and I have never owned anything with an engine other than a car, and my dad always did the car stuff. My neighbor Mr. Okonkwo has been very sweet about showing me how to mow and all that. He suggested a pressure washer for the driveway because the previous owners let moss go crazy. So I got the FH-P90.

It worked okay the first couple of times. Now the pressure is really low and the spray surges, like it goes strong then weak then strong, over and over. I did watch a video that said to check the hose and I did, no kinks. Then I tried the other nozzle tips and same thing.

I also need to wash the driveway by this Saturday because my parents are visiting and my mom is going to inspect everything, I just know it. Can you help me figure out what's wrong, and whether it's something I can fix myself? I also lost the little booklet, sorry. Thanks so much! Cassie

subject: Teeth wearing out on stump grinder
body: Howdy! We've got the FH-520 up at the farm and it's been a workhorse, but lately it feels like it's just slow, takes forever to chew through a stump. Looked at the cutter wheel and a few of the teeth are rounded off and one has a chip in it. Can I replace just the worn ones or do I need the whole set? And where do I get them? Appreciate it!

subject: Gasolina goteando del generador
body: Esto es inaceptable. Mi generador FH-G7 está goteando gasolina cerca del motor y el silenciador mientras está funcionando. Lo apagué enseguida porque me da miedo que se incendie. Vivo en el campo y dependo de este generador cuando se va la luz. Quiero saber qué pasa y cómo lo arreglan. Número de serie FHG7-23-05562. Espero respuesta pronto.

subject: Pump leaking after freeze
body: Hi there! I have a quick question, and I'm hoping it's an easy answer. I left my FH-P90 in the garage over the weekend and we had a surprise freeze Friday night. Yesterday I went to wash the car and the minute I turned it on, water started to leak from the pump area and I got basically no pressure out of the wand. I turned everything off. I'm pretty sure I should have drained it or something, I just never thought about it. Is the pump cracked? Is it repairable, or do I need a new pump? I'm okay with doing some of the work myself if there's a part I can order. It's maybe about a year old. Thanks a bunch for any help you can give me, I really appreciate it!

subject: FH-340 shaking and rattling
body: I own 40 acres and I have been running the FH-340 for about a year. Over the last few weeks it has started shaking like crazy, the whole frame is bouncing, there's a rattle that wasn't there before, and the chips come out stringy and uneven instead of clean. I've been through this machine's manual twice and it says nothing useful about what causes this. I haven't hit any rocks, as far as I know. I am tired of babysitting this thing. If there is something loose or a blade issue, tell me what to check, and if it's a defect I want to know what you are going to do about it. I don't have time to haul this into a shop and wait weeks. Reply by email please. Serial FH340-23-08817.

subject: Chipper clogging
body: The FH-340 clogs up whenever I put wet or leafy branches in. Dry oak goes through fine. I have a pile of green hedge cuttings and a lot of cedar and it stops every few feet. The engine bogs down and I have to shut off and clear the chute by hand. Is there a way to stop that, or is the machine just not meant for green material? I'd like to know before I spend the whole weekend fighting with it.

subject: Generator stops after a few minutes
body: Hello. I bought an FH-G7 recently and this is my first generator. It starts easily, but after about five minutes it shuts itself off. I have tried restarting it and it does the same thing each time. I have checked the fuel and there is plenty in the tank. Please could you tell me what might cause this? Thank you in advance for your help.

subject: stump grinder slow
body: My FH-520 barely cuts now. Teeth look chewed up, couple are chipped. Taking forever per stump. What do I do?

subject: ram slow
body: my fh210 ram is real slow now and stalls on bigger logs it never did that befor. wat shoud i check

subject: Chipper
body: FH-340 engine runs, drum won't turn, noise.

subject: Chipper shaking - gift for mom
body: Writing quick because I'm at work. I got my mother an FH-340 chipper for her birthday in August. She has a big property and she's been dealing with storm debris. She called me last night and said the whole thing shakes like crazy when it's running, there's a rattling noise, and the chips are coming out all stringy and uneven, not like the demo video on your site. She's 71 and I don't want her messing with it if something is loose. Is it safe for her to keep using it? What should she check, and who can look at it? I can arrange to pick it up and drop it off if we need to take it somewhere. The order number is FE-105921. Please email me, not her, she doesn't check email much. Thank you.

subject: Won't start after storage
body: pressure washer FH-P90 sat all summer, wont start now, pull and pull and nothing. Really annoyed, it was only used twice. What now?

subject: Quick question about my FH-210
body: Hi! So my dad's birthday present, the FH-210 log splitter, has been getting lots of use already, he's thrilled, he's been telling everyone at church about it. I'm writing because he said something happened last weekend when a chunk of wood popped off the wedge and clipped his leg, nothing serious he says, but I thought I'd mention it. What I really wanted to know is whether it's normal for the wedge to need sharpening after a month or two. Also he can't find the serial number plate. Where is it located on the machine? Thanks so much!

subject: Broken engine, warranty?
body: Hello. My FH-340 chipper stopped working after about four months of regular use at my home. The engine runs but the machine will not feed material, and I'm not sure what has failed. I would appreciate help diagnosing it and would like to know whether the repair would be covered by warranty. My order number is FE-103390. Separately, where can I buy spare parts, such as replacement blades? Thank you.

subject: FH-P90 leaking and no pressure
body: Hey y'all! Something weird happened with my FH-P90. We had that freeze last week and the washer was in the garage, and today when I turned it on, water was leaking out of the pump and there was basically zero pressure at the end of the wand. I shut it right off. Did the cold crack something? Is there a way to fix it or do I need a new pump? Thanks in advance!

subject: Pressure washer hose problem
body: Good morning, hope the fall is treating you well! I wanted to write because I've been very pleased with the FH-P90 for cleaning the cabin and the dock. It works like a champ. Last time out, though, one of the hose fittings blew apart in my hand, well, the water sprayed across my hand and left a nasty welt, I put some ice on it and I'm all right. Anyway, I wanted to ask whether you sell the hose fitting by itself, or the entire hose, and what size it is. I'm a retiree with plenty of time, so I'm happy to do the work myself. Thanks a lot, and have a great day!

subject: Generator pull cord
body:
Dear Fernhollow Equipment Supply,

I trust this message finds you well. I am a retired civil engineer, and I live on a wooded lot with my wife of forty-one years. We purchased the FH-G7 portable generator last year as insurance against the ice storms that so often visit our county. In fact, we lost power for three days last January, and I swore that I should never be unprepared again.

I tested the generator briefly after purchase and it performed adequately. I attempted to start it this week, in anticipation of the coming winter, and discovered a difficulty: the engine does not start, and the pull cord is very hard to pull. It resists strongly after the first few inches, and I am concerned that I will injure my shoulder or damage the recoil assembly if I force it.

I would be grateful for your advice on what may cause this and whether it is something I can address myself. I am generally handy, but I would not wish to void any warranty by attempting a repair prematurely.

With thanks,
Cornelius Whitlock-Ames
Serial: FHG7-23-07714

subject: Pulsing pressure
body: Good afternoon. The spray from my FH-P90 has begun to pulse and the pressure is lower than before. Could you advise what I should check on my property? Thank you kindly.

subject: Log splitter issue - for my father
body: Good afternoon. I purchased an FH-210 for my father. The ram will extend but does not return after a split, and the pump makes a whining sound. Kindly advise on the next steps.

subject: Stump grinder squealing
body: Well, I finally got around to taking out the old cottonwood stump behind the barn with the FH-520, and wouldn't you know it, the cutter wheel quits the second it touches the wood and the belt squeals like a stuck pig. I gave it a few tries and kept getting the same result. I'm not sure whether I need to tighten the belt or replace it. I don't want to run it more and burn it up. Any advice? Thanks.

subject: Winter storage tips
body: Hi! Can you tell me how to look after my FH-340 over winter and how often I should sharpen or swap the blades? Thank you so much!

subject: Leaky hydraulic hose
body: Hey, small leak on the FH-210. Hydraulic fluid is weeping from a hose fitting down near where the hose meets the pump, enough to leave a dark spot on the barn floor. Haven't used it since I saw it. Do I need a new hose or just a tighter clamp? Let me know and thanks, appreciate the help.

subject: Burning smell, smoke, panel
body: I paid good money for this FH-G7 and it started smoking from the control panel while I was running my well pump and a couple of tools. Burning plastic smell, shut it off and unplugged everything. I'm out in the country, an hour from the nearest shop, and I need this thing to work when the power goes. What do you plan to do about this? I'd like to know whether it needs replacing and how fast you can get someone to look at it.

subject: Generator outlets dead
body: Hi! New FH-G7 owner. Engine runs great but the outlets have no power, a breaker button might have popped. Help please!

subject: Fuel dripping on my FH-340
body:
Good day. I am a retired man with a few wooded acres, and I use my FH-340 chipper mostly for pruning and storm cleanup. Yesterday, while it was running, I noticed gasoline dripping down near the engine and what I believe is the muffler. The drip was slow, but steady, and it fell near hot metal. I shut off the engine at once and moved the chipper away from the shed. I have not started it since.

I am not sure where the fuel is coming from. It may be the fuel line, the carburetor, or the tank itself, but I am no expert. I would appreciate it if you could tell me what the most likely source is and what a safe fix would be. If a part needs to be ordered, please tell me which one. I would prefer to have it repaired properly rather than take any risks with fire. Thank you very much for your time.

Archibald Teller

subject: Maintenance schedule FH-210
body: Quick one before I lose the daylight. Running the FH-210 on the farm pretty hard this fall, probably 15 to 20 hours a week lately. When do I change the engine oil, and when the hydraulic oil? Is there a filter that needs swapping and where is it? Also how often do I check wedge sharpness, and do I grease anything? The manual that came in the box covers some of this but it's vague. I'd also like to know the right way to put it away for winter, since last year I just threw a tarp over it and I'm guessing that wasn't ideal. If there's a service chart you can email me, that would be perfect. I know I'm asking a lot of questions. I'll be out in the fields until dark, so email works best. Thanks for the help.

subject: Generator dies
body: FH-G7 runs a couple minutes then stops. Need it fixed asap, storm coming.

subject: chipper dead after winter
body: FH-340 sat in the garage all winter and now won't start. Tried pull cord 20 times. Super frustrated, my yard is a mess of branches.

subject: Stump grinder stops when cutting
body: Hi, I'm new to all this equipment stuff. I bought the FH-520 to take out a few stumps in my yard. When I lower the wheel to the stump, the wheel just stops turning and the belt starts squealing, and I'm worried I'm going to wreck it. The engine keeps running fine. I tried it on two different stumps, same thing. What am I doing wrong, or is something broken? Also, where do I buy spare belts and parts? Thanks.

subject: FH-P90 surging
body:
Hi folks, hope your week is going better than mine. I'll try to be brief but I tend to ramble. We have a little cabin on the lake that we got from my wife's family about six years ago, and we only get up there a few times a year, mostly in the summer and for a long weekend in October. Every season the dock and deck get covered in green slime, so the FH-P90 lives in the cabin shed.

Anyway, this past trip I fired it up and the pressure was way down, and then it kept surging, like it was gasping, strong, then weak, then strong. It did the same thing the whole time, about two hours, until we gave up and used a brush. I checked the water hose and it looked fine. Is that a clogged nozzle, pump trouble, or the inlet filter? I can poke around if you tell me where to look.

Our cat knocked over the gas can in the shed, by the way, so I suppose it might have been bad fuel, but I didn't think so. We're back up in two weeks. Thanks!

subject: Gas leak at engine
body: Hi there! Thank you in advance for your time. I have a question about my FH-210 log splitter. I've used it all fall at our house, it's been a lifesaver, and I split a whole winter's worth of wood in about three weekends. Today though, while it was running, I noticed gas dripping from underneath the engine, near the muffler, and a bit of a gasoline smell. It was a steady drip. I shut it off right away and backed away. I let it cool for a good while and haven't tried restarting. Do you know where the leak might be coming from? I'm worried about fire, and I don't want to run it again until I know it's safe. Is this something I can fix myself, like replace a fuel line, or should I bring it to a shop? Order number FE-108814. Thanks again, I really appreciate any help.

subject: Splitter incident - FH-210
body: Good evening. I have been using my FH-210 to split hardwood for several seasons. I would like to report that last Sunday, as I was working on a stack of locust, a section of wood flew from the wedge and struck my leg. I was not seriously hurt, and I had on boots. I am writing to ask what could have caused the log to eject in this manner, whether my splitting technique may be at fault, or whether the wedge or the beam may be worn or misaligned. I would also appreciate it if you could confirm the correct placement for the log. Thank you for your response.

subject: Power at outlets - nothing
body: Ugh, I'm so frustrated. I bought the FH-G7 for the first time ever because we lose power constantly where I live, and the one time I need to test it, the engine runs but I get nothing out of any outlet. I plugged in a lamp, a drill, and a heater, three different things, and nothing. A little breaker switch on the side keeps popping out, and when I push it back in it pops right out again, or at least it did once. I'm not electrically inclined at all and I don't know whether I'm doing something wrong. I don't want to touch anything inside. This is a pricey unit and I expected it to just work. Can someone please tell me what's going on and how soon I can get this resolved? I'd like to know before the next storm. My order number is FE-111047.

subject: FH-G7 smoking
body: I'm very upset. I'm retired, I live out in the woods, and I rely on that generator when the lines go down in winter, which they do. I hooked up my FH-G7 on Friday to the chest freezer and a few other things. It ran for about an hour. The storm had been awful, I'd lost two old trees, my neighbor's fence was down, you know how it is. Then I noticed a burning smell and a bit of smoke from the control panel and I shut it off at the switch and unplugged everything quick. My hands were shaking afterwards. I haven't tried running it again. What I would like to know is what is wrong with it, whether it is safe, and what you are going to do to fix it. I am not paying for a repair on something that's under a year old. Please call me or email, whichever is faster.

subject: Pump leak after cold
body: FH-P90 leaks and no pressure after freezing night. Please help.

subject: Generator won't start / stiff pull cord
body: Hello, I hope someone can help me. I have a small farm and I keep the FH-G7 for when the power goes out. I went to start it today for the first time in a while, because I like to test it before winter, and the pull cord is extremely hard to pull. I can barely get it to move more than a few inches, and when I do manage a full pull, the engine does not start at all. I've checked that the fuel valve is on and the switch is on, and I added fresh gas from a new can. I haven't tried taking the cover off because I don't want to break anything. Could you please tell me what might cause the cord to stick, and whether it's something I can fix on my own or if I should send it back to you? I'm happy to send photos. Thank you very much for your time, and I look forward to hearing from you.

subject: FH-340 defective - refund demanded
body: I bought the FH-340 chipper for my mother and it shakes violently, rattles, and produces stringy chips. This is dangerous and defective. I demand a full refund or a replacement immediately.

subject: Pressure washer and a question on the hose
body: To whom it may concern, I'm a retiree with a wooded lot outside town and I bought an FH-P90 earlier this year. Overall it does the job on the deck and the shed. I'm writing because the last time I used it a high-pressure hose fitting burst while I was working and the jet caught my hand. It cut the skin and bled, and my wife had to take me to urgent care for stitches. I'm still not happy about that. I would like to know why the fitting failed, whether this is a known problem with the hose, and what you plan to do. My order number is FE-106602. Please reply in writing.

subject: Log splitter too slow
body: Third time this month the FH-210 has choked on logs it used to eat for breakfast. The ram creeps forward, then stalls halfway. We only use it a few weekends a year at the cabin, so I figured the thing would last. Whoever answers this, tell me what is wrong with the pump or the oil or whatever it is. I'm tired of splitting by hand with an axe. Serial FH210-22-03388.

subject: Hydraulic leak, FH-210
body: Hello. My FH-210 has a hydraulic leak from one of the hose fittings. I noticed fluid on the ground after use. I live on a wooded lot and use the splitter a few times a month. Could you tell me whether this fitting can be tightened or must be replaced, and how I can order the part? Thank you.

subject: Grinder teeth
body: Howdy! The teeth on my FH-520 are looking pretty beat up and it's cutting slow as molasses. Can I get replacements? Thanks, y'all!

subject: Parent's log splitter stopped working
body: Hello, I bought an FH-210 for my mother as a present about seven months ago. She doesn't use it very often, just for the occasional firewood. It has now stopped working properly and she can't find what the problem is. Would you be able to tell me what the next step is? We would also like to know whether the repair is covered under warranty. We have the receipt and the order number is FE-102876. Thank you for your help.

subject: Ram not retracting
body: Dear Sir or Madam, I recently purchased an FH-210 log splitter, my first. After each split, the ram extends fully but will not retract, and the pump emits a high whining sound while the lever is held. I have not attempted any repairs. Please advise on the cause and on the proper next steps. Thank you.

subject: Chipper keeps clogging on mom's yard
body: Hi! I got my mom an FH-340 chipper for Mother's Day and she loves the idea of it, but she keeps calling me about it clogging up. Whenever she feeds in green or leafy branches, especially after rain, it jams, and she has to turn it off and pull the stuff out. She's careful about it, she waits for it to stop. I'm wondering whether that's just how it works with wet material, or if something needs adjusting. Is there anything she can do to avoid it? Thanks so much for any tips!

subject: FH-340 squeal, drum stuck
body: Good afternoon. The engine of my FH-340 runs, but the chipper drum does not turn and a squealing noise is present. Please advise on the cause and repair.
